Build a researcher profile

Source: R/researcher-profile.R
sm_researcher_profile.Rd

One-shot workflow: fetch all works for a researcher by ORCID, enrich, embed, and build a trajectory analysis.

Usage

sm_researcher_profile(
  orcid,
  sources = c("openalex"),
  enrich = c("oa_status"),
  embed = FALSE,
  trajectory = TRUE,
  mailto = Sys.getenv("SCIMAPR_MAILTO")
)

Arguments

orcid

ORCID identifier.

sources

API sources to query.

enrich

Enrichment steps to run.

embed

Logical; compute embeddings?

trajectory

Logical; build trajectory analysis?

mailto

Email for API polite pool.

Value

An sm_corpus with trajectory attached as attribute.

See also

Other trajectory: is_sm_trajectory(), sm_author_trajectory(), sm_plot_collab_turnover(), sm_plot_topic_pivots(), sm_plot_trajectory(), sm_trajectory

Examples
